style.backgroundSystem: flat matte lilac claim field #B9B3E6 for benefit, scene and variant screens, seamless off-white studio field #F6F5F7 for packshots and blank proof panels
style.direction: playful premium ready-to-drink chocolate beverage ecommerce
style.iconSystem: flat thin-line pictograms in deep cocoa #4A2B21 plus empty shield and seal outlines only, no real certification marks and no award laurels
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key neutral studio light, front-left softbox key with bounce fill, soft contact shadows grounding every unit, one controlled highlight on the cap, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful premium ready-to-drink beverage visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of an off-white studio field #F6F5F7, a flat lilac claim field #B9B3E6, deep cocoa #4A2B21 and one vermilion accent #D8342A; bright even high-key neutral studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, bounce fill, soft contact shadows and one controlled highlight on the cap; matte warm cream counter #EAE1D8 and blank matte white pedestal blocks #F7F5F2 as surfaces; one rounded heavy geometric sans-serif headline band with small geometric sans labels, all wording carried only as placeholders; flat thin-line pictograms and empty seal outlines in deep cocoa; the upright unit held at full height with a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no real certification or award marks, no duplicated pack artwork.
noDrift: no real certification or award marks
no duplicated pack artwork between units
style.presentationRules: the upright unit keeps full height, a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and one fixed scale across the set, front label plane always turned to camera and never covered by props or hands
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm cream laminate counter #EAE1D8 for table scenes, blank matte white pedestal blocks #F7F5F2 for variant steps, off-white panel stock #FBFAF8 for spec layouts
style.typography: one rounded heavy geometric sans-serif headline band with small geometric sans labels, every wording carried as a placeholder and never as readable copy
